title: 第1087章 李清然的道生一剑第1086章 不能放水了
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“嘶——这小妮子有点东西啊……”
云层深处，玉慈真人盘腿坐在金色雷眼顶端，晃着悬空的腿，扒着雷眼边缘往下瞅。
见李清然周身剑气护盾圆转如意，连衣角都没被雷风吹乱，她不禁挑了挑眉。
那层剑气护罩浑然一体，锋芒内敛却密不透风，不像是临时催动的防御术，倒像是刻进了骨子里的剑道本能。
“不对劲，”她摸着下巴嘀咕，“区区十几年修行，剑气掌控力能到这份上？
指不定是陈怀安给她留了什么护身宝物。
靠着外物成仙可不行，打铁还需自身硬啊……”
玉慈真人指尖一弹，一缕清气注入身下雷眼。
雷眼金光微涨，第二道雷劫应声劈落，威力比第一道凭空涨了三成。
李清然不闪不避，剑气护罩微微一震，便将雷光卸得一干二净。
第三道、第四道……一直到第十道雷劫，玉慈真人步步加码，雷力从金纹雷升到紫霄雷，一道比一道狂暴。
可无论雷霆如何劈砸，那层淡青色的剑气护罩都只漾开几圈涟漪，始终稳如泰山，李清然连脚步都没挪动过半分。
“还真不是纯靠宝物。”
玉慈真人坐直了身子，脸上的漫不经心收了起来。
她能清晰感觉到，那护罩里的剑气纯粹凝练，全是自身修为打磨出来的，没有半分外力加持的滞涩感。
一个修行十几年的晚辈，能把剑气驾驭到这种地步，已经不能用天才形容了。
“行，那咱们来点真格的。”
她双手掐诀，全力催动天道雷眼。
第十一道雷劫落下时，不再是简单的雷柱，而是凝聚成了一头张牙舞爪的雷龙，龙身蜿蜒百丈，咆哮着撞向李清然。
李清然终于动了。

她手腕轻转，长剑自鞘中划出一道清光，
身形踏空而起，迎面而上。
“剑式——长风破浪！”
“叮——”
剑尖精准点在雷龙眉心最薄弱处，狂暴的雷龙瞬间僵住，随即寸寸崩碎，化作漫天雷光洒落。
接下来的二十五道雷劫，玉慈真人变着法子催发雷霆。
什么雷枪、雷网、雷阵、雷山……
形态各异，威力层层攀升。
李清然则以剑破之，挑、劈、横、卸，剑招简洁利落，没有半分花哨，每一剑都落在雷霆的法则破绽上。
三十六道登仙雷劈完，北海海面已被雷霆劈得沸腾蒸腾，白茫茫的水汽直冲云霄，千丈巨浪此起彼伏，整片海域都在震颤。
跟上来在安全距离观礼的月影宗众人，早已数得手心冒汗。
“三十六道了……三十六道登仙雷已满，怎么劫云还没散？”苏祈年扒着山石往前探，头发还带着之前的焦糊味，脸上满是难以置信。
寻常修士飞升，一般九道雷便是顶配。
content_en:
"Hiss—there's something about this little girl..."
Deep in the clouds, Master Yuci sat cross-legged on the top of the golden thunder eye, swinging his legs in the air and looking down at the edge of the thunder eye.
She couldn't help but raise her eyebrows when she saw that the sword energy shield around Li Qingran's body was in perfect order, and even the corners of his clothes were not disturbed by the thunder wind.
The shield of sword energy is integrated into one, and its edge is restrained but airtight. It doesn't look like a temporary defense technique, but rather like the instinct of swordsmanship carved into the bones.
"Something's wrong," she rubbed her chin and muttered, "After just ten years of practice, how can you control sword energy to this level?
Maybe Chen Huaian left some protective treasure for her.
It’s not enough to rely on external things to become an immortal. To forge iron, you need to be strong yourself..."
Master Yuci flicked his fingertips, and a wisp of fresh air was injected into the thunder eyes under his body.
The golden light of the thunder eye rose slightly, and the second thunder calamity struck down in response, its power increased by 30% compared to the first one out of thin air.
Li Qingran did not dodge or evade, the sword energy shield shook slightly, and then completely removed the lightning.
The third, fourth... until the tenth thunder tribulation, Master Yuci increased his power step by step. The thunder power rose from the golden pattern thunder to the purple sky thunder, each one became more violent than the last.
But no matter how the thunder struck, the light blue sword energy shield only made a few ripples, and remained as steady as a mountain. Li Qingran didn't even move his feet.
"It's really not just about treasures."
Master Yuci sat up straight, and the carelessness on his face disappeared.
She could clearly feel that the sword energy in the shield was pure and condensed, all polished by her own cultivation, without any stagnation caused by any external force.
A junior who has been practicing for more than ten years can control the sword energy to such an extent that it can no longer be described as a genius.
"Okay, let's get serious."
She made a secret with her hands and used all her strength to activate the Thunder Eyes of Heaven.
When the eleventh lightning tribulation fell, it was no longer a simple thunder pillar, but condensed into a thunder dragon with fangs and claws. The dragon's body snaked hundreds of feet, roaring and crashing into Li Qingran.
Li Qingran finally moved.
She turned her wrist lightly, and the long sword drew a clear light from its sheath,
The body rose into the air and faced him.
"Sword style - long wind and waves!"
"Ding——"
The tip of the sword was accurately pointed at the weakest point between the Thunder Dragon's brows. The violent Thunder Dragon froze instantly, and then shattered inch by inch, turning into thunder and lighting all over the sky.
In the next twenty-five thunder tribulations, Master Yuci changed his methods to trigger the thunder.
What kind of thunder gun, thunder net, thunder formation, thunder mountain...
There are different forms, and the power increases step by step.
Li Qingran used his sword to break it, picking, slashing, crossing, and discharging. His sword moves were simple and neat, without any flashiness. Every sword strike fell on the flaws of Thunder's law.
After thirty-six lightning bolts were struck, the North Sea surface was boiling and steaming. White water vapor shot up into the sky. Thousand-foot-high waves surged one after another, and the entire sea area was trembling.
The people of the Yueying Sect who followed and watched the ceremony from a safe distance were already sweating from the palms of their hands.
"Thirty-six steps... Thirty-six steps of Climbing Immortal Thunder are full, why haven't the clouds of calamity cleared up yet?" Su Qinian picked up the rocks and looked forward. His hair still smelled like it was burned before, and his face was full of disbelief.
For ordinary monks to ascend, Nine Rays of Thunder is usually the best match.
